## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are from my own GitHub account and use the `type(scope): message (#issue)` format
- [ ] Names match the Sprint 2 vocabulary and OpenAPI (`docs/api/openapi.yaml`); if the contract changed, the version was raised and `story-mapping.md` regenerated
- [ ] Mermaid diagrams render in the GitHub preview; links work
- [ ] Documentation is in English
- [ ] Tests added or updated (code PRs); CI is green
- [ ] No secrets or real personal data (no `.env`, only synthetic data)
- [ ] Reviewer assigned (not myself); milestone and project set as on the issue
